exposure: Streptococcus B screening by delocalised PCR on admission
outcome: completeness of antibiotic prophylaxis against Streptococcus B
reasons for incomplete prophylaxis (e.g., rapid labor, omission)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 236 pregnant patients who tested positive for Streptococcus B carriage via delocalised PCR on admission to the maternity hospital between January 2022 and February 2023.
finding: Delocalised PCR for Streptococcus B on admission allowed complete antibiotic prophylaxis in 63.6% of cases, with rapid labor being the main reason for incomplete prophylaxis in 11.9% of patients.
